The necromancer {npc:Omrabas}, hidden in the ruins of {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, wants to come back to life. Over three volumes you gather body parts for him, consecrate the five altars of the star-shaped room and recover the five pieces of an enchantment scroll. In the end the ritual fails (the scroll was a chicken soup recipe!) and Omrabas, furious, gives you the {item:Nail Case}, needed to tame the {wiki:Hellgrip|Hellgrip} mount.
If you are not afraid of taking part in dark ceremonies, look for Omrabas and offer him your help. He has something very *handy* as a reward for your assistance.
Loose Stone Pile leading to Omrabas's hideout, Drefia
{spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels} to climb up in the northern ruins (Vol. 1, Ch. 3).
Ability to take on {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Blood Priest|Blood Priests} and vampires in the crypts.
to open several holes and dig up Dragon Tears and fragments
only if you do not have the Levitate spell
Blood Priest and Blood Hand loot
Blood Priest, Blood Hand or Shadow Pupil loot
or Large Yellowed Bone; Omrabas also gives you one if you say 'problem'
used to tame a Gravedigger and get the Hellgrip mount
At the end of the quest {npc:Omrabas} gives you the {item:Nail Case}, with which you can tame a {creature:Gravedigger}.

Before you start, ask {npc:Lugri} for the task of 4000 {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Blood Hand|Blood Hands}, {creature:Blood Priest|Blood Priests} or {creature:Shadow Pupil|Shadow Pupils} ({wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of...}). You will kill many of these creatures during the quest, so the kills count towards the task.
Mark on the map the hole that leads to the star-shaped room ({coord:32997,32397,10}): you will pass through there at least 5 times.
Several rooms (the amphorae, the Dormitory room and the final altar) only let **one person in at a time, for 5 minutes**. If entry is refused, someone is inside.
You can pick up the loot items (Ghoul Snacks, Demonic Skeletal Hands, Half-Eaten Brains, Blood Tinctures, Magic Chalk) in advance to speed up the quest.
If you lose a quest item, Omrabas usually gives you another one: {key:lost} (heart), {key:bone} (key), {key:parchment} (parchment), {key:candles} (candles), {key:problem} (bone).
Omrabas needs body parts to prepare his resurrection. First, two arms.

First go to **Darashia**: by boat (say {key:hi}, {key:darashia} and {key:yes} to your city's captain; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}). {wiki:Drefia|Drefia} is **west** of Darashia ({coord:33018,32443,7}), on the other side of the mountains that separate Ankrahmun, Darashia, Drefia and Tiquanda. There are several paths: for example, use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain here {coord:33048,32429,7}, or come through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun. On the mountain there are lots of {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}: save mana to cure the poison.
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia

Drefia is split into two halves: the **north** part (big ruins, Omrabas, Necromancer Halls) and the easier **south** part. Use {spell:Invisible} or a {item:Stealth Ring} to cross the surface without fighting.

In the northern part of {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, go down to the indicated {item:Loose Stone Pile (Omrabas)|pile of loose stones} ({coord:33020,32453,8}) and use the {item:Shovel} on it: you are teleported down, straight into {npc:Omrabas}' room ({coord:33020,32453,9}).
Loose Stone Pile to Omrabas' hideout
The stone pile is a one-way teleport down. To leave the hideout, return to the surface the way you came to the pile. You will come back here after every mission: mark the pile on the map.
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. Omrabas asks you for two arms: 2 {item:Ghoul Snack|Ghoul Snacks}.

Kill {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} until you have 2 {item:Ghoul Snack|Ghoul Snacks}. There are lots inside Drefia; if you want to prepare beforehand, the {wiki:Mount Sternum/Undead Cave|Mount Sternum Undead Cave} is also a good spot.
Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. He complains that the arms have no hands and asks you to talk to him again in a minute.
Wait about a minute before talking to him again.
Receiving the request for the hands
After a minute, say {key:hi} to Omrabas. He asks for 2 {item:Demonic Skeletal Hand|Demonic Skeletal Hands}. If you want, ask about {key:skeletal hands} so he confirms where to get them.
Kill {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} until you have 2 {item:Demonic Skeletal Hand|Demonic Skeletal Hands}.
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi} and {key:yes}.
Omrabas' heart is hidden in an amphora in a sealed mass grave, in the deepest cellar of his old house, in the northern ruins, by the beach.
Say {key:mission} to Omrabas. He asks you for his heart.

Go to the ruins in the far north of Drefia. Go up with {spell:Levitate} (*exani hur up*) or by stacking 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}, and go down the stairs. Then go down **2 more floors** until you find a teleport. Bring {spell:Levitate} (or the Parcels) for the way back too.
Ruins in the north of Drefia (go up with Levitate)
Map of the path to the amphorae
Enter the teleport. Use each {item:Dusty Amphora} to break it (it becomes {item:The Remains of a Dusty Amphora}). Repeat until you get the {item:Omrabas' Heart}.
Only **one person at a time** gets in and the room is yours for 5 minutes. If access is refused, someone is inside. You may find a {creature:Lich} in the room.

With the heart in your backpack, leave the amphora room (you only have it for 5 minutes) and go back the same way: climb the **2 floors** and the stairs to the top of the ruins. To go back down to the sand of Drefia use {spell:Levitate} (*exani hur down*). Then return to Omrabas' stone pile ({coord:33020,32453,8}).
Ruins in the north of Drefia
Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and then {key:give}.

If you lose the heart, say {key:lost} to Omrabas and he lets you fetch another. If you want to keep a spare heart, do not have it in your inventory when you talk to him: that way you can fetch a second one and hand that in.
Now Omrabas wants a {item:Stimulated Brain}, made with 2 {item:Half-Eaten Brain|Half-Eaten Brains} in the Brain Heater Machine of the Necromancer Halls.
Kill {creature:Zombie|Zombies} until you have 2 {item:Half-Eaten Brain|Half-Eaten Brains}. Besides Drefia, the {wiki:Cemetery Quarter|Cemetery Quarter} of Yalahar is a good option.
Going down to the main dungeon
Go to the entrance of the main dungeon, northwest of Omrabas' dungeon, and go down **3 floors** to the main area (Necromancer Halls). You arrive at the Necromancer Halls here: {coord:33003,32413,10}.
Entrance to the main dungeon of Drefia
Arrival at the Necromancer Halls (3 floors down)
Head **northeast** until you find the big hole with dead cyclopes. Walk straight **north** from that hole and you find 4 sacrificial altars in pools of blood and water.
Path to the Brain Heater Machine
Put the two {item:Half-Eaten Brain|Half-Eaten Brains} on the sacrificial altars and use the machine to the north of them. A {item:Stimulated Brain} appears on the central altars. Pick it up.
Putting the brains on the altars and using the machine

Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}.

To leave the Necromancer Halls, go up the **3 floors** by the same stairs to the entrance of the main dungeon ({coord:32996,32412,7}) and go back to Omrabas.
Say {key:mission}. Omrabas wants something alive to serve as intestines and gives you an {item:Empty Storage Flask}.
Find a **live** {creature:Snake} and use the {item:Empty Storage Flask} on it. Mages can summon a snake. There is a snake that spawns inside Drefia and a few more in the mountain pass to the desert.
Snakes in the mountain pass to the desert
Do not kill the snake! You have to use the flask on it while it is alive.
Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. You have finished **Volume 1**.
Volume 2 consists of consecrating the five altars of the star-shaped room (fiveserrated room). The first one is the Dragonsoul Altar, which needs 3 {item:Small Dragon Tear|Dragon Tears}.
Accepting the consecration of the altars

On the surface of Drefia, go down the **northeast** hole. Follow the cave wall **southeast** until you find the stairs to the dragon graveyard (there is a sign that says *"Here be Dragon Bones"*). Go down and walk **northeast** to a teleport.
Stairs to the dragon graveyard (Here be Dragon Bones sign)

Enter the teleport, go down and dig with the shovel at the three spots marked in blue in the image. If you forgot the shovel, there is a {item:Shovel} on a human corpse in the **southeast** corner of the room. Each tear gives a different message:

With the 3 tears, go back the same way: return to the teleport and the stairs of the *Here be Dragon Bones* sign ({coord:33031,32432,8}) and follow the cave wall **northwest** to the northeast hole. Use the {item:Rope} to go up to the surface ({coord:33012,32412,7}).
Go to the entrance of the main dungeon, go down **3 floors** and find the hole **north** of the stairs you arrived by. Open it with the shovel and go down. You are in Drefia's star-shaped room.
Hole to the star-shaped room (mark it on the map!)
Star-shaped room with the numbered altars

Mark this hole on the map: you will come back here at least 5 times. To leave the room, use the {item:Rope} on the hole you came down through and go up the 3 floors of the main dungeon to the entrance ({coord:32995,32412,7}). This is always the way back after each altar.

At the **east** end of the room there are two level 60 expertise doors ({wiki:Medusa Shield Quest|Medusa Shield Quest}). Directly **south** of them is altar 1, behind the dragon statues. Use the dragon tears on the **east** side of the altar. They are all consumed and the message *"The dragon tears glow and disappear. The old powers are appeased."* appears.
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi}.
The second altar is the Bonemarrow Altar: you need to hallow a yellowed bone in the Gardens of Night and burn it on the altar.
You find {item:Yellowed Bone|Yellowed Bones} here and there all over Drefia. If you cannot find one, say {key:hi} and {key:problem} to Omrabas and he gives you one from the pile of skulls.
Going to the Gardens of Night

Go to the main dungeon, go down **3 floors** and head **northeast** to the cyclops pit. Go straight **north** through 2 rooms and turn **east**. Walk east until you pass a bar and turn **north**. You are in the {wiki:Gardens of Night|Gardens of Night} (dark and white sand, dry trees and Priestesses).

At the end of the Gardens of Night, find a passage through the **east** wall of the cave. You see several piles of hallowed bones. Use your {item:Yellowed Bone} (or {item:Large Yellowed Bone}) on one of them to get a {item:Hallowed Bone} (or {item:Large Hallowed Bone}).
Piles of hallowed bones in the Gardens of Night
Burn the bone on the Bonemarrow Altar (altar 2)

Take the bone to the star-shaped room. The Bonemarrow Altar is directly **south** of the previous altar (number 2 in the image). Use the bone on the fire and you receive the message *"The flames roar and eat the bone hungrily. The Dark Lord is satisfied with your gift"*.
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi}.

The third altar is the Bloodgong Altar. You need 4 {item:Blood Tincture in a Vial|Blood Tinctures in a Vial}, which drop from {creature:Blood Priest|Blood Priests} and {creature:Blood Hand|Blood Hands}.
Kill {creature:Blood Priest|Blood Priests} and {creature:Blood Hand|Blood Hands} until you have 4 {item:Blood Tincture in a Vial|Blood Tinctures in a Vial}.

In the star-shaped room, go to the **southwest** altar (number 3). Use a blood tincture on **each** of the 4 sacrificial stones. On each one *"You crash the vial and spill the blood tincture. This altar is anointed."* appears.
Use the {item:Bloodgong Statue} (north of the stones). Musical notes appear and the message *"<BOOOOOOOONGGGGGG> A slow throbbing, like blood pulsing, runs through the floor."*
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi}. You receive **1500 experience** when you greet him.
The fourth altar is the Fireglass Altar. You need holy ashes, made with magic chalk in the fire of the Ember Chamber.

Kill {creature:Blood Priest|Blood Priests}, {creature:Blood Hand|Blood Hands} or {creature:Shadow Pupil|Shadow Pupils} until you have 1 {item:Pieces of Magic Chalk}. You find these creatures in the {wiki:Necromancer Halls|Necromancer Halls} and connected rooms. If you forget, say {key:chalk} to Omrabas so he repeats where to get it.
Go to the main dungeon, go down **3 floors** and head **north**, passing a room with a pool. Turn **west** and find a passage to the **southwest**: it is the antechamber. Go down the stairs.

Find the {item:Strange Fire} to the **southeast** of the stairs. Use the chalk on the **flames** (it does not work on the ashes). *"The flame wavers as it engulfs the chalk. Strange ashes appear beside it."* appears. Pick up the {item:Shadow Ashes} left in the fire. The fire is here: {coord:32977,32371,11}. Then go up the antechamber stairs and go back through the Necromancer Halls to the hole of the star-shaped room.

Go to the star-shaped room, to the **northwest** altar (number 4). Use the ashes on **both** {item:Sacrificial Stone|Sacrificial Stones}. *"The ashes swirl with a life of their own, mixing with the sparks of the altar."* appears.
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi}.
The last altar is the Shadowthrone. You need 3 human tallow candles, kept in a hidden library in the lich caves.
Get the key and the scroll
Say {key:proceed}. Omrabas gives you the {item:Omrabas' Bone Key} and an {item:Old Parchment (Omrabas)|Old Parchment}.
Going down to the caves in the east
Go down at the indicated spot and follow the path in the image.

If nobody has pulled monsters, you only find one {creature:Lich}, one {creature:Necromancer} and several {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}. Further into the cave there are 2 {creature:Gravedigger|Gravediggers}, 2 more Liches, another Necromancer, 3 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and more rats.
Go **south**, go up the stairs and come back down. Use the key on the {item:Trapdoor|trapdoor}. You fall through it (*<swoosh> <oomph> <cough, cough>*) and end up in a small library.

In the **north** part of the room there are 4 sets of {item:Some Strange Candles|strange candles} on a table. Use the parchment on any of them. *"Reading the parchment, you identify three human tallow candles and pocket them."* appears. You get 3 {item:Candle Made of Human Tallow|Candles Made of Human Tallow}.
If you lose the candles (or want to keep some for yourself), go back to Omrabas and say {key:candles} to restart this mission. If you lose the key or the parchment, say {key:bone} or {key:parchment}.

The trapdoor is down-only and the wiki does not describe the exit of this small library. Once you have the candles, leave the room and go back through the lich caves to the descent you entered by ({coord:33014,32413,7}); from there head to the main dungeon and the star-shaped room.
On the way back the {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Gravedigger|Gravediggers} and {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers} of the caves are still there.
Placing the candles on the Shadowthrone (altar 5)

Go to the star-shaped room, to the altar in the **north** corner. There are 3 statues. Use a candle on each statue **in this order**: first the **bottom left** one, then the **bottom right** one, finally the **top** one.
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi}. You have finished **Volume 2**.
The enchantment scroll has been torn into five pieces, one for each of Omrabas' old friends. The first is with a blood priest.
Accept the search for the scroll
Look for the blood priest {npc:Tomruk the Ruddy}. Say {key:scroll} and {key:yes}. He gives you 2 empty {item:Blood Vial|Blood Vials} for you to fill.
Go to the necromancers' Pure Blood Chambers, in the **southeast** of the {wiki:Necromancer Halls|Necromancer Halls}. Use the **first** empty vial at the spot in the image.
Use the FIRST empty vial here

Go to the {wiki:Vampire Crypts|Vampire Crypts}: go down at the first spot, walk a little **north** and go down at the second spot. Then walk **west** to the third spot. You see blood running down the wall into a pool: use the **second** vial there. Then leave the Vampire Crypts the same way: go up through the two spots you went down by ({coord:33012,32457,11} and {coord:33005,32480,10}; bring a {item:Rope} for the holes) to the Necromancer Halls.

Go back to {npc:Tomruk the Ruddy} with the two full vials. He gives you a vial of {item:Tainted Blood Essence}. Use it on the 4 {item:Blood Pagoda|Blood Pagodas} in the middle of the room and then pull the lever to the **north**.
Talk to Tomruk again. He takes 1–2 minutes to prepare and then gives you the {item:Incantation Fragment}. Take it to {npc:Omrabas}.
Be patient: Tomruk takes a minute or two to hand you the scroll.
The second piece is with {npc:Oblivion}, who only gives it to you if you answer three questions whose answers are on graves in the Vampire Crypts.

After you hand in the first fragment, Omrabas sends you to {npc:Oblivion}, in the far **north** of the {wiki:Necromancer Halls|Necromancer Halls}. Follow the path in the image and ask him about the {key:scroll}. He sends you to look for three graves in the Vampire Crypts.
Going down to the 2nd floor of the Vampire Crypts
Go to the {wiki:Vampire Crypts|Vampire Crypts} by the same path as for the blood vial, but this time go **north** to the stairs that go down to the second floor.
You may run into {creature:Arachir the Ancient One} or {creature:Gravelord Oshuran} on the way to these stairs!

Find the three graves marked with a green check mark on the map and **use** each tombstone to read it. When you are done, go back the same way: go up the 2nd floor stairs and the two descent spots to the Necromancer Halls.

Here there are {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, {creature:Vampire Viscount|Vampire Viscounts}, {creature:Vampire Bride|Vampire Brides} and {creature:Gravedigger|Gravediggers}.
After reading the three graves, go back to {npc:Oblivion} and answer his questions, in this order:

With the three right answers, Oblivion tells you the piece is buried next to Akab's grave, **south** of the main area, near the Dormitory. Dig **immediately to the right** (east) of the tombstone to get the {item:Incantation Fragment}.
Go back to {npc:Omrabas} and talk to him about the mission to hand over the fragment.
The third piece belonged to Omrabas himself.
Ask Omrabas for the next mission. He gives you the {item:Omrabas' Copper Key}.
Entering the room with no door

Go down the stairs of the main ruins. In the {wiki:Necromancer Halls|Necromancer Halls}, go a little **north** to a room with no visible door. On the **southwest** wall there is a big golden ornament: use the {item:Omrabas' Copper Key} on it and you are teleported inside. There is only one {creature:Ghost} in this room.

Go to the **northwest** part of the room, where there is a chest in front of two bookshelves. The floor is cracked to the **right** of the bookshelf: use the cracked floor. You get a white server message saying someone left a card, and a parchment appears on top of the crack.
Go **south** to the Dormitory and enter the teleport. You end up in a small room with stairs going down.

Be careful if you are low level: this room has 3 {creature:Zombie|Zombies}, 3 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} and a {creature:Lich}. Only one person can enter at a time (maximum 5 minutes).

In the room there is a {creature:Necromancer Servant}. After you go down the stairs you **cannot go back up** until you kill it. When you kill it, it drops the third {item:Incantation Fragment}. Only after you kill it can you go back up the stairs; then leave the room before the 5 minutes run out and return to the Necromancer Halls.
Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}.
The fourth piece is with a priestess who only talks to necromancers.
Say {key:yes} to Omrabas. He gives you the {item:Omrabas' Magic Cape} to disguise yourself as a necromancer.

Go down the stairs of the main ruins and then go down the stairs to the **north**, after the hole of the star-shaped room. On the way there are a few {creature:White Shade|White Shades} and a {creature:Gravedigger}. Go to the **north** of the room to find {npc:Elyen Ravenlock}.
Stairs north of the star-shaped room hole
Disguising yourself and asking for the scroll

She only talks to necromancers: **use** the {item:Omrabas' Magic Cape} to disguise yourself and only then say {key:hi}. Answer {key:yes}, ask for the {key:artefact} (or the {key:scroll}) and accept with {key:yes}. She gives you a {item:Flute Made of a Single Bone}.
Playing the flute at the 5 shrines

Go to the {wiki:Gardens of Night|Gardens of Night}, **northeast** of the Necromancer Halls (near where you hallowed the bone). The 5 {item:Strange Shrine|Strange Shrines} look like {item:Magic Pillar|Magic Pillars} and are outside and **north** of the two rooms. Start with the one in the image and follow the path north to find all 5. Use the flute on each one.
Start at this shrine and head north

If *"That didn't come out right. You should try again."* appears, use the flute again on the same shrine. At the end, use it again on all of them to confirm: if you have already played for one, it says *"You already played for this shrine."*
Reporting to Elyen and opening the chest of drawers

Go back to {npc:Elyen Ravenlock}, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. She keeps the flute and lets you through the tiles right **east** of her. In the {item:Chest of Drawers (Quest)|chest of drawers} immediately after those tiles is the {item:Incantation Fragment}.
Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. He takes the cape back.
The last piece: the ghost {npc:Zarifan} knows where it is, but only reacts to the magic words "Friendship lives forever".
Say {key:yes} to Omrabas. He gives you the magic words.
Going to the south of Drefia
Leave the northern part of Drefia and go to the **south** part. Enter the hole marked in the image.
Hole in the south of Drefia
Go down **3 floors**. Down there, go **west** (a narrow path with sand on the floor) and then **south**. You find a hole: go down and you are next to {npc:Zarifan}.
Be careful if you are low level: there is a {creature:Lich} and other creatures near the stairs.

Say, **in this order**: {key:hi}, {key:magic}, {key:friendship}, {key:lives}, {key:forever}. Zarifan tells you the piece is buried in the sand, between a triangle of big stones, in the caves in the east. Then leave the same way: go up through the hole next to Zarifan (use the {item:Rope}) and the **3 floors** to the south part of Drefia.
Leave and go back to the south part of Drefia. Open the {item:Loose Stone Pile} with the shovel and go down through the hole here:
Open the second {item:Loose Stone Pile} and go down through the hole here:
Go down **two** more times, go **north** and turn **right** (east). You should reach this spot:
Digging in the middle of the triangle

You see three stones in a triangular formation. Dig **exactly in the middle** of them. You get a {item:Torn Incantation Fragment}. To leave, go back the same way: go up the two floors and the two holes of the stone piles with the {item:Rope} to the surface ({coord:33074,32474,7}). Then cross to the northern part of Drefia.
Dig in the exact centre of the triangle
Go back to Omrabas, say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. The fragment is incomplete and he sends you to look for a copy in his old library, next to the star-shaped room.
Go to the {wiki:Necromancer Halls|Necromancer Halls} and follow the path to the Vampire Crypts in the image. You find a hole: open it with the shovel and enter the room.

Go **north** in the room. There are two bookshelves (one to the north and one to the west). Use the **north** bookshelf to get a {item:Crumpled Paper}. To leave, use the {item:Rope} on the hole you entered through ({coord:32995,32450,10}) and go back through the Necromancer Halls.
Use the {item:Torn Incantation Fragment} on the {item:Crumpled Paper}. You get an {item:Incantation Fragment}.
Go back to Omrabas and say {key:hi} and {key:restore}. He puts everything together into an {item:Incantation Scroll}.
Say {key:ready} to Omrabas. He gives you the {item:Omrabas' Talking Skull}.

Go to the star-shaped room, to the altar that is **exactly halfway** between the southwest altar and the southeast one. Enter the teleport, put the skull on the **middle of the altar** and use the scroll on the skull. *"The scroll burns to dust. The magic stutters. Omrabas' soul flees to his old hideaway."* appears and a {creature:Chicken} spawns on the altar. You earn the achievement **Gravedigger**.
Only one person can enter at a time and you have 5 minutes. When you are done, leave the altar room and go back to the star-shaped room; leave it with the {item:Rope} through the hole you entered by.
Leave the room and go back to Omrabas. Say {key:hi}: he blames you for the failure (the scroll was a chicken soup recipe) and gives you the {item:Nail Case}. You have finished the quest!

There is no shortcut out: return to the surface (through the exit of Omrabas' hideout) and cross the mountain back to **Darashia** the same way you came (by the rope spot {coord:33048,32429,7} or through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun). In Darashia take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Rope spot between Drefia and Darashia
The {item:Nail Case} is used to tame a {creature:Gravedigger} and get the {wiki:Hellgrip|Hellgrip} mount.
The quest summary lists 2 {item:Small Ruby|Small Rubies} in total; the guide records the handing in of one in Vol. 3, Ch. 2.
If the message *"The key breaks off. Perhaps you should talk to Omrabas."* appears when you use the bone key, talk to Omrabas ({key:hi}) to continue.
